name: Hookdash Self-Hosted Webhook Gateway
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted webhook ingestion, signature verification, SQLite-backed delivery queue, retry/backoff, dead-letter queue, replay and dashboard. No vendor-imposed event quota or expiration for the software; capacity depends on own infrastructure.
watch_out: Software only: no free managed webhook endpoint, compute, storage, or bandwidth. Dashboard authentication and per-source rate limiting are listed as roadmap items, not shipped features; do not expose dashboard publicly without independent access controls, HTTPS and network restrictions. Very early-stage project with no upstream push observed since 2026-07-11; production reliability, security and maintenance are unverified. Review license and deployed dependencies before commercial deployment.
